# 1403. Minimum Subsequence in Non-Increasing Order

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def minSubsequence(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        nums.sort(reverse=True)
        min_sum = sum(nums) // 2
        ans = []
        cur_sum = 0
        for num in nums:
            ans.append(num)
            cur_sum += num
            if cur_sum > min_sum:
                break
        return ans
```
